lessons.claim: A recurring failure shape across two systems: verify a condition for ONE PART of a system, then apply the conclusion to the whole. Four instances. Sedimentation l_g: predicted for an idealised fit window rather than the one the estimator's count floor leaves. Optical trap kappa: compared against 2*U0 rather than against the same parabolic fit applied to the exact p(x). Correlation time: tau_int measured on the mean height applied to a dense-region observable that decorrelates far faster, nearly killing an affordable campaign. Escape: the operating window was sized on the DEEPER trap's escape barrier while the SHALLOW trap limits the run (11.2 kT vs 14, 13x the rate). The check is cheap: name which part of the system each condition was verified on, and whether any other part is more limiting.
